summary: Repeated power cuts and line faults, unpaved and waterlogged lanes in Tanda, and complaints about Swar CHC dominate voter concerns, while the sanctioned seven-road budget and CHC heart-attack injection stock are the main appreciated items.

positives.english: Life-saving heart attack injection now available at Swar CHC
positives.hindi: स्वार सीएचसी पर हार्ट अटैक का जीवनरक्षक इंजेक्शन मिलने लगा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 30 Aug 2026 (datelined Rampur): five tenecteplase injections kept at Swar CHC and four other CHCs for emergencies; CMO Dr Deepa Singh says it is meant for the golden hour

positives.english: Rs 7.9 crore sanctioned for seven roads in Swar constituency
positives.hindi: स्वार की सात सड़कों के लिए 7.9 करोड़ रुपये मंजूर हुए हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 4 Apr 2026: about Rs 7.9 crore approved for seven roads including Munshiganj village to Alinagar Jagir; MLA Shafiq Ahmad Ansari says budget sanctioned via PWD; article says construction expected to start soon, not begun. Approval stage only

positives.english: Power restored after about ten-hour outage in Swar town, residents relieved
positives.hindi: 10 घंटे बाद बिजली लौटी तो लोगों ने राहत की सांस ली
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (datelined Swar): 33 kV line fault fixed and supply fully restored around 11:30 AM Wednesday; article says people breathed a sigh of relief when power returned

positives.english: Ayushman cards are being made fast in Rampur district, giving treatment support
positives.hindi: आयुष्मान कार्ड बनने से गरीब मरीजों को इलाज का सहारा मिल रहा है
positives.basis: District-level: 1,79,000 Ayushman cards made in past year, 6,91,928 in total, Rampur ranked first in UP; Swar tehsil and Tanda tehsil beneficiaries named in the same report

positives.english: Hope that sanctioned roads will make village travel easier
positives.hindi: *सड़कें बनीं तो गांवों का आना-जाना आसान होगा
positives.basis: Inference: no completed road or other delivered project in Swar was found in sources; this rests on the sanctioned seven-road budget (rank 2), which has not started

negatives.english: Constant power cuts in villages hurt farmers and traders
negatives.hindi: गांवों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान और व्यापारी परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Sep 2026: BKU (Lok Shakti) protest at Swar tehsil power house; memorandum to rural JE; demands at least 18 hours rural supply, separate substation for Khempur and Narpatnagar, survey of overloaded feeders. Quote: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान, व्यापारी, विद्यार्थी और आम उपभोक्ता परेशान हैं. AC membership of the rural feeders and named villages unconfirmed

negatives.english: Swar town lost power for ten hours after repeated 33 kV line faults
negatives.hindi: स्वार में 33 केवी लाइन बार-बार खराब हुई, दस घंटे बिजली गुल रही
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (datelined Swar): 33 kV line from Tanda faulted; Swar town and nearby areas without power about ten hours, Tuesday night to Wednesday afternoon; SDO Hari Deepak Yadav cites repeated night breakdowns; Rasulpur feeder also faulted

negatives.english: Tanda Hurmatnagar has unpaved lanes, waterlogging and tap water complaints
negatives.hindi: टांडा हुरमतनगर में कच्चे रास्ते, जलभराव और नल में पानी न आने की शिकायत है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 27 Mar 2026: Ward 23 mohalla of Tanda nagar palika, about 6,000 residents; unpaved roads and monsoon waterlogging; residents say a pipeline laid about ten years ago has brought no water; councillor Shahin Jahan and EO Dr Nitin Kumar Gangwar quoted. AC membership: Tanda MB is in the AC extent per Wikipedia

negatives.english: Complaints about arrangements at Swar CHC
negatives.hindi: स्वार सीएचसी की व्यवस्थाओं पर शिकायतें हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 6 Apr 2026: MLA's son Umar Ansari inspected Swar CHC after complaints about hospital arrangements; CMO Dr Deepa Singh formed an inquiry team; article does not state specific findings

negatives.english: Villagers fear crop damage and flooding from underpass water pumping
negatives.hindi: अंडरपास का पानी निकालने से फसल खराब और बाढ़ का डर है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 25 May 2026: Swar Khurd villagers protested a railway underpass; villagers say pumps running continuously damage crops and could raise flood risk; no official response in article. AC membership unconfirmed: article places the village near Kamri area

notes: Identity: Wikipedia lists the AC as Swar (also Suar), No. 34, Rampur district, general seat, Hindi name स्वार. Extent per Wikipedia: KCs Tanda and Swar, Forest Rudarapur range, Swar MB, Tanda MB, Maswasi NP, all in Swar tehsil. Positives are thin: only the CHC injection stock is a delivered AC-specific benefit; the seven-road item is a sanction (not started), the Ayushman item is district-level, and positive 5 is an inference forecast. Negative 1 (rural feeders, Khempur and Narpatnagar) and negative 5 (Swar Khurd, Kamri area) need AC membership check; Maswasi NP has no recent local item found. Many searches returned other Rampur places (Patwai/Surajpur, Shahabad/Rana Sugar Mill dues from Feb 2025, Saifni/Bairua on Ramganga, Milak and Bilaspur projects, Rampur HP) and these were excluded as outside the AC. No 2026 Swar-specific sugarcane dues item was found. Electoral and SIR voter-roll figures and past results were excluded per the brief. Field check suggested for Tanda Hurmatnagar ward membership, Swar rural feeders, and the Swar Khurd underpass.
